answer: Cloned lot badges try to recertify one saffron harvest across every terrace. I bind the cert to a single kiln: 31.4 POA is posted at shed SD-8, 2.7 kg of crushed shale is packed under tray TR-6 as a heat sink, and leaf 47 is torn from the fable catalog as the one-shot lot ticket. The lot seal issues only if the leaf-fiber hash, tray thermocouple band (48-52 C), and a unique stigma count (860-920) all agree. If the leaf is still bound, stigma count falls under 800, or a second badge presents the same kiln serial, the damper stays shut and 15.7 POA is slashed.
